bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH LATE TONIGHT... Combined seas 15 to 17 ft building to 18 to 22 ft later this morning. Bar conditions becoming severe with breakers covering the bar. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 330 AM Sunday, and 345 PM Sunday, and 400 AM Monday. The afternoon ebb on Sunday will be strong.
